mission.title: Poison for a Parasite
mission.description: Collect live flies from the Assassin and test the new insecticides on them.

npc.say: Great. I won't keep you any longer, operative; you go ahead and take off. I gotta stay here for a sec and set a few concussion charges--don't want the Exiles or Machines finding this gear intact. Let Anome know that the white insecticide tested positive, okay?

phase.briefing:
Hello, {player}. Today's a big day: you get to play with our first batches of the two pesticides designed to destroy the Assassin, that vomit-eating, parasitic program infecting the City like a clammy tapeworm wrapped around a starving man's bowels.
All set? Super. But first we'll need some live blowflies from the Assassin. I'm sending you to a building where he's just been spotted. I'm not exactly sure how to go about getting live flies from him, but I'm sure you'll think of something.

enter.say:
"Get live flies from the Assassin," he says, easy as you please. Like nice Mr. Assassin will just give some to us if we ask politely!
That's the building where he was seen. The code looks normal...but then again, we've never got a solid reading on the Assassin.
Well, great. That looks like the Assassin's handiwork, all right. I'm still not picking up any unusual live code around there. Keep moving.
Eesh, more carnage. Hey, I'm picking up some blowfly code in there... On the body, maybe?

done.say: Darn it, those flies are all dead. Looks like we didn't get here quickly enough. Better head outside and see if Anome can get us intel that's a little more up-to-date.

phase.briefing:
So, what, it's my fault that you didn't get there quickly enough to get live flies?
We've got another reported Assassin sighting. I suggest moving your fat ass with a little more dispatch this time.

enter.say: I'm reading some live Exile signals inside. Maybe we're in time?
Exiles? This could be trouble. They might be there to cover the Assassin's tracks.

done.say: That body looks like the Assassin's MO, but I don't see any trace of his flies in the area. I'm sure Anome will love this.

phase.briefing:
Assassin sightings don't grow on trees, operative. And every failure here costs lives.
Unfortunately for his victims, and fortunately for you--how ironic, don't you think?--he seems to be on a bit of a rampage today. We've got another hot tip--don't blow this one.

enter.say: I'm picking up live signals inside--redpills.
I just lost one of the redpill signals. The other one-- Wow! What the hell? I've never seen a signal like that before. It's gone now. Came from the next room.
That body must be the redpill signal that just dropped; looks like the Assassin's work. Hey, check the corpse. I think that poor bastard may be our jackpot.

done.say: How about that: live Assassin flies! Better keep a tight lid on those buggers. Bring them outside and...uh, do it quick, because I think you've got an Exile cleanup crew paying you a little visit there.

phase.briefing:
I hope you have good news for me, operative?
Well, what a pleasant surprise. Now, I want you to take those lovely little insectae to our field contact, Alden. She has the insecticide prototypes that we will test on the flies.

enter.say:
I'm reading Alden's signal nearby.
You know what would be funny? If, after all this, the insecticides didn't work on those blowflies. ... Except that wouldn't really be funny. Man, those insecticides had better work, or we are all jacked up.

objective.text: Give the live blowflies to Alden

talk.say: Good, you're here. We have to move fast; the other factions would kill to get their hands on this stuff. First, I need you to give me those blowflies.

done.say: Okay. One of those boxes has a small supply of our special red insecticide. Go get it.

objective.text: Get the red insecticide from the box

done.say: That's it. Now, I need you to put that insecticide in the computer test apparatus here.

objective.text: Put the red insecticide in the test apparatus

done.say: Great. I have to concentrate on managing these live blowflies, so I need your help. Lead me over to that computer apparatus.

objective.text: Start the red insecticide test at the apparatus

done.say:
Exposing half of the captive blowfly population to the red insecticide...now.
And...nothing. I see increased movement, but it isn't killing them--just making them angry. So much for the red insecticide. Let's try the white. Get our test supply from the other box here.

objective.text: Get the white insecticide from the other box

done.say: Now put the white insecticide into the second computer test apparatus.

objective.text: Put the white insecticide in the test apparatus

done.say: Okay. Lead me over to the apparatus while I keep the lid on these pissed-off blowflies.

objective.text: Start the white insecticide test at the apparatus

done.say:
Exposing the captive blowflies to the white insecticide...now.
Hey... Hey, it worked! They're dead! Hah, we've got the Assassin's number now!
Thanks for your help with this little test.

complete.say: Great. I won't keep you any longer, operative; you go ahead and take off. I gotta stay here for a sec and set a few concussion charges--don't want the Exiles or Machines finding this gear intact. Let Anome know that the white insecticide tested positive, okay?

mission.finish:
The white insecticide killed the Assassin's flies, you say? Excellent, excellent. I wish I could have been there to see it. Tell me, did the flies make any...unusual noise as the fatal white vapors seeped through the joints of their iridescent exoskeletons? You didn't notice? You really should pay more attention to these little details, operative.
But, yes, this is a significant victory for Zion. Once we get a delivery mechanism for the white insecticide, the Assassin is cooked--stewed in our bitter, toxic juices, if you will. And with that, {player}, I bid you good day.
